title: Sports Club Murder Case
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Inspector Megure) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed, attributed edge between the entities involved (person/location/object), sharing an `order` integer so edges belonging to the same occurrence can be grouped without a reifying node. The victim was secretly blackmailing all three suspects over different secrets, so two red-herring has_motive_against edges (Saeki over tax evasion, Naruse over an affair) sit alongside the true culprit's motive -- a direct fix of v1's near-total label leak, since v1 only recorded a vague, unconnected motive for the culprit and none for the others. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: There was no blood, hair, or sign of a strike anywhere on the diving platform, even though the death was staged to look like a diving accident where the victim hit his head -- proving the fatal injury actually happened poolside and the cap was used to disguise that.

The earplugs found on the victim's body don't match the ones he was seen wearing during afternoon practice -- the killer re-plugged his ears with the wrong pair after knocking him out with chloroform.

The elderly witness's painting, made faithfully from what he saw that night, shows an earring glinting on the silhouetted diver's ear -- Saijo never wore one, but Kijima does, proving the person on the platform impersonating Saijo that night was actually Kijima.
